title: Mother and Child on Crowded Ocean Beach, 1950 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing a mother in a patterned floral swimdress tending to a small child seated in the wet surf along an ocean shore. In the background, numerous bathers wade and swim in the gentle rolling waves. Inscribed with 'July 1950' along the bottom front margin, the photograph evokes mid-century American family leisure and post-war summertime seaside vacations.
